name: How long does it take to install water-efficient bathroom fixtures?
description: Installation time ranges from minutes for aerators to several hours or a full day for toilets or multiple fixtures, depending on complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install water-efficient bathroom fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installation time for water-efficient bathroom fixtures varies. A simple replacement of a showerhead or faucet aerator can be completed in minutes. Replacing a toilet typically takes a few hours, while installing multiple new fixtures or a hot water recirculation system may require a full day or more, depending on existing plumbing configurations. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption.
